title: Parse bounded HTTP Retry-After values
instruction: Complete retry_delay while preserving its API. value is either non-negative decimal delta-seconds or an RFC 7231 HTTP-date. now must be a timezone-aware datetime and max_delay a positive integer. Convert a future date to whole seconds using ceiling so a positive fraction never becomes an immediate retry; past dates return zero. Clamp every valid result to max_delay. Reject booleans, malformed values, signed/negative delta forms, naive datetimes, and invalid max_delay with ValueError. Do not consult the system clock, change now, or add dependencies. Add regression tests.

author_metadata.notes: V2 screening lineage for deterministic protocol-date interpretation and boundary rounding.
